title: Rationalization of the specified completed-pullback unit
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $A=\mathcal O_E$ and $\varpi$ a uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme with $\ell$ invertible. On its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] put $B_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/\varpi^n)_X$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and $E_X=B_X[1/\varpi]$. Module sheaves, sheaf tensor products, derived categories and cohomology are as in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Write $\mathcal C_X=D^b_c(X,A)$ for the completed integral category including compatible etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], and $Q:\mathcal C_X\to\mathcal R_X=\mathcal C_X[1/\varpi]$ for its raw rationalization [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. A rational module sheaf is constructible when on a finite locally closed stratification it is pro-etale locally finite free [def-constructible-stratification, def-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-module]. Write $F_X(K)=E_X\otimes^L_{B_X}K$ and $J_X(QK)=F_X(K)$, $J_X(f/\varpi^n)=\varpi^{-n}F_X(f)$ for the functor specified in [lem-per-rational-module-realization-functor]. Let $g:X'\to X$ be any morphism between schemes with the same scheme hypotheses. Define $B_{X'},E_{X'},\mathcal C_{X'},Q,J_{X'}$ in the same way. Let $c_g:g^{-1}B_X\to B_{X'}$ be the coefficient map defined by its finite quotient projections, and put $P_gK=B_{X'}\otimes^L_{g^{-1}B_X}g^{-1}K$. Let $\widehat P_g$ and $\gamma_{g,K}:P_gK\to\widehat P_gK$ be exactly the completed pullback and quotient-tower completion unit of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Then $P_gK\in\mathcal C_{X'}$ for $K\in\mathcal C_X$ and $\gamma_{g,K}$ is an isomorphism. On pulled-back stratified perfect local models $B_S\otimes_A^LP$ the ordinary pullback has model $B_{S'}\otimes_A^LP$; completeness and the compatible etale witnesses are retained. These conclusions concern the specified unit, as in [lem-tw-ordinary-completed-integral-pullback, lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization, lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. There is a natural comparison
$$\alpha_{g,QK}:J_{X'}(Q\widehat P_gK)\xrightarrow{\sim}E_{X'}\otimes^L_{g^{-1}E_X}g^{-1}(J_XQK).$$
It is the composite of $J_{X'}(Q\gamma_{g,K}^{-1})$ with balanced tensor flattening; both ordinary sides identify with $E_{X'}\otimes^L_{g^{-1}B_X}g^{-1}K$. The localization unit identification $g^{-1}E_X\cong(g^{-1}B_X)[1/\varpi]$ is the canonical one [lem-weil-pbc-localization-inverse-image-coherence]. The comparison descends to fraction morphisms and hence to a natural isomorphism on raw rationalizations. No isomorphism $g^{-1}B_X\cong B_{X'}$ is assumed.
